conversationalSummary.text: TODAY there’s probably no reliable window, and I wouldn’t bother chasing it—wind looks like the main problem and the consistency is pretty sketchy for Cerro. Tide is rising with a bit of push, but with the current swell it may just feel too soft and messy rather than worth the drive. I’d check Surfline or MEO Beachcam first, and unless the cams look much better than expected, I’d save the session.

best.explanation: Cerro looks like a fun-sized window for Too soft, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 50 kJ, 9 s period, lully 15/100, and wind is the main risk.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; wind angle is poor for this spot; Cerro may feel too soft without more push.
best.shortExplanation: Cerro is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  It looks too soft to make the drive worthwhile.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
